response.description:
The public preview of Microsoft-managed performance
monitoring for Azure SQL Managed Instance is now available. Customers monitoring business-critical SQL Managed Instance
workloads often rely on custom scripts and disconnected monitoring tools. This
requires them to manage telemetry infrastructure and manually correlate
performance insights across their SQL Managed Instance estate. The new experience collects and stores performance telemetry
and provides resource-level and at-scale dashboards to help identify
performance trends, anomalies, and resource bottlenecks. For deeper analysis
and custom visualizations, you can securely query their monitoring data using
Kusto Query Language (KQL) through an RBAC-protected Azure Data Explorer proxy
endpoint. Learn more:  Documentation Announcement
blog
response.title: Public Preview: SQL performance monitoring for Azure SQL Managed Instance
